items.text: Enkae kiguana natudung'okoki Babilon
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura, kaputu nanu enkiyang'et enkidaaroto metigilunore Babilon, negilunore lelo oomanya Kaldea;
naa kairriwa Babilon ilasilak naa kepuo aasil ninye, naa keitorok ninche enkop enye, tenepuonu aarare ninye te pooki shoto teina olong e nyamali.
Mincho ilo ong'orisho te nkauo eyietu enkawuo enye, nimincho ninye meitasho eeta imasaa enyena o larrabal mileku ilbarnot lenyena; indaikie tukul ilororani lenyena pooki.
Kebatata ninche etaraki metuata te nkop oo Lkaldayo, netipikaki ilbaa too nkoitoi enyena naalala.
Amu eitu eing'ua Israel o Yuda Enkai enye, Olaitoriani loo lororani; kake ore enkop oo Lkaldayo nebore enkitarruoroto tialo ilo Sinyati le Israel.
“Esika entung'uai empolos e Babilon, enchoo pooki tung'ani eitajeu enkishui enye! Emincho edung'ori intae te nkitamioto enye amu enkata e lap o Laitoriani ena, enkitalakunoto naitalak ninye.
Etiu apa Babilon anaa enkikompe e sahabu te nkaina o laitoriani, eitemer enkop pooki; etemerate iloreren te naisho enye oo sabibu, neaku eshomo nkuapi etarruoitie ilukuny.
Etabatate nabo kata Babilon negila; teyietu nchiraki ninye! Ewaita olchani te nkaraki emion enye. Eidimayu pee eishiunyeki ninye.
Emb 18.5

Anaata iyiook kinchiunye Babilon, kake eitu ninye eishiu tung'uai ninye, maape iyiook oltung'ani ake enkop enye makewan; amu ore endung'okinoto enye e nkiguana netabaikia shumata netudumuaki aailepie omeitabaikini nkatampo.”
Etabawua enkata pee eilepie iyiook Olaitoriani enkilepioto ang, wou, maibalunye iyiook tiatua Sion esiaai o Laitoriani Enkai ang.

“Eiyio nena baa! Entudumu ilong'oi! Etuputuo Olaitoriani oltau loo laiguanak le Amedi, amu ore eyieunoto enye tialo Babilon naa pee eidakie ninye, amu ina elap o laitoriani, elap te nkaraki enkaji enye.
Entipik ilmonek isunta e Babilon; Entagolo ilarripok. Entipik ilarripok; Entobira ilnukat. Amu eitobira Olaitoriani neitabayie ina apa nairoro tialo lelo oomanya Babilon.
Emb 17.1
Oi iyie oton too nkariak kumok, karsis too lchumat etabawua enkiting'oto ino, etudung'oki o lpiyayoil le nkishui ino.
Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai te kewan enye: Esipa kaaiput nanu iyie iltung'ana ooba anaa ilmaat, naa keilepie ninche embuakunoto e nkisulata nikisulie ninche iyie.
Osinkolio le nkisisa e Nkai
Enyuntu e Nkai
Enkitamioto e Babilon
“Kalaaki nanu o lelo pooki oomanya atua Ilkaldayo te dukuya nkonyek inono teina torroni apa pooki nataasa ninche te Sion, Olaitoriani ojo.

“Ng'ura kaarare nanu iyie ele otiu anaa oldoinyo oinyalisho, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo oidaikie enkop pooki; kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai pee aarare iyie, naa kaibeleleng'oo nanu too ndapidapo naaitaa nanu iyie oldoinyo otapejoki.
Nemeitayuni te iyie osoit oitaae o lo lmairroto, nemeitayuni osoit lo lkitamyunoto, kake iaku iyie mijooni anaake Olaitoriani ojo.

“Tuuno iyie enanka te nkop, toosho entarumpeta tiatua iloreren, ntobiraki nkuapi olarrabal tialo ninye, mpotoki ninye nkitoriat meetu aarare ninye, Ararat, o Mini, o Askenas; Entegelu olarikonile njore oarare ninye. Eyautu mbartan naaba anaa olmaati.
Ntobiraki nkuapi olarrabal pee earare ninye lelo aiguanak le Mede, tenebo ilbalusuni lenye, o laretok lenye, o pooki kop natii abori enkitoria enye.
Eikirikira enkop te mion, amu eitashe nkitobirat o Laitoriani ear Babilon, pee eitaa enkop e Babilon mitil, nememanya tung'ani.
Etapala ilmurran le Babilon olarrabal, ebikito ninche too sempewueti lenye eishunye engolon enye etaa ninche nkituaak eibung'ita enkima imanyishoritin enye. Etigilate ntaloishin oo nchomito enye.
Eipirri oltung'ani anang'are olikae nenang'are olkilikuai olikae pee eliki olaiguanani le Babilon nchere eibung'aki enkanasa enye te pooki shoto.
Eibung'aki iwuejitin neelang'ieki too lkejek netapejoki iwuejitin neeisudoriyieki te nkima neiputukunyo isikarini lo larrabal.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Etotiwuo entito e Babilon anaa osoit oiutuutishoreki tenakata naitunyoki, ore ake eyia naa tenkiti kata naa kelotu enkata e nkisampuare enye.”

“Nebukadresa ilo aiguanani le Babilon laatumuta nanu, aatupurda ninye nanu, aaitaa ninye empirbil narok aatoijoie ninye anaa enkukuu. Eiputa ninye enkoshoke enye intokitin ainei e sikar, aaiturrayie ninye anotu.
Metijing'a shumata Babilon ina kinyalata naainyalaki nanu o ltung'ana laainei.” Nchoo ilo omanya Sion ejo, “Metijing'a osarge lai shumata lelo oomanya Kaldayo. Nchoo Yerusalem ejo.”
Keretu Olaitoriani Israel
Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, kaamitu nanu naitalaku elap te nkaraki iyie. Kaitoi nanu enaiposha enye naitoi enkong'u enye e nkare,
naa keaku Babilon osototi loo suut neaku emanyisho oo mbariak ewueji olkirutoto o enking'asia nememanya tung'ani.
Keikurrukur ninche tenebo anaa ilng'atunyo; neishir anaa ilkuoon lo lng'atuny.
Ore te nkure enye naitobiraki nanu ninche, naitemer nanu ninche o metishipata neirura ninche nkolong'i pooki nemeigil aainyototo, Olaitoriani ojo.
Kaitadou nanu ninche anaa ilkuoon le kerra oopuoi aayieng, anaa ilmeregeshi o loroi.
Enalo adoiki Babilon
“Eng'ura eneikunayioki Babilon, ewaki ina naikasie enkop pooki eng'ura aajo etaa Babilon entoki naitureisho too loreren!
Eilepaka enaiposha Babilon, eitemoyioki ninye te lelo apir le naiposha kumok.
Etaa nkanas enyena entoki naitureisho enkop natoiwuo olpurkel, enkop nememanya hoo ng'ae nemeim hoo oltung'ani atua ninye.
Naa kaitame nanu ina ai e Babilon naji Bel, naitayu tiatua enkutuk enye ina toki natoijoyie meitoki nkuapi aarukokino ninye etusulari esuntai e Babilon.
“Empang'a enchom te mpolos enye, lo tung'ana laainei! Nchoo pooki tung'ani eitajeu enkishui enye teina goro napi o Laitoriani!
Emimputukunyunyu nimiruturutu teilo marenke oning'o te nkop tenelotu olomoni to lari obo. Neitoki ake olomoni alotu to likae ari netii olarrabal enkop nearare oloitoreisho likae oitoreisho.
“Neaku, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i pee aitame nanu nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e Babilon; neitukurruni enkop enye pooki, ore lelo tung'ana lenyena pooki ootaraki metuata te mpolos enye.
Netum taa shumata o enkop, o pooki natii atua ninche, aatarany te ng'ida tenkaraki Babilon amu kelotu oloidaikie aarare ninche oing'uaa moikuape, Olaitoriani ojo.
Meeta nchere mebatata Babilon tenkaraki lelo ootuata le Israel, amu tenkaraki Babilon etabatatate lelo loo nkuapi pooki ootuata.
Olkilikuai le Nkai too ltung'ana le Israel ootii Babilon
“Ore intae oo imishote to lalem, enchom, emintashe aaitirring'a! Entadamu Olaitoriani tenelakua enchoo Yerusalem elotu ndamunot inyi:
‘Eitukurruaki iyiook, amu kitoning'o embuaakinoto eimulumulayie esulare inkomomi ang amu eetuo iltung'ana loo loreren atua iwuejitin sinyat e nkaji o Laitoriani!’
“Neaku, ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, pee adung'oki nanu enkiguana nena kitanyaanyukot enyena naa ore tiatua enkop enye pooki neishir te mion lelo oata ilbaa.
Ore hoo nerupa Babilon abaiki shumata ore hoo naa keitagol ailepie ine neshurie, ore ake eyia naa kepuonu ilainyalak ooidaikie ooing'uaa enatii nanu aapuonu enetii ninye, Olaitoriani ojo.
Enkae kidaata e Babilon
Eirriwayioki olkilikuai le Yeremia meshomo Babilon

Ele rorei apa eitanapa Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai Seraia olayioni le Neria, olayioni le Mahaseia ina kata apa pee elo tenebo Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda Babilon, to lari liong'uan le nkitoria enye. Olaitasheikinoni apa Seraia.
Neiger apa Yeremia tiatua embuku ina torroni pooki nalotu shumata Babilon, kulo rorei pooki apa eigeroki ooipirta Babilon.
Nejoki Yeremia Seraia: “Tinilotu kenya Babilon, toduaa nchere isuma iyie kulo rorei pooki,
nijo iyie Olaitoriani, itejo inaaipirta ene wueji nchere iwuang'ie iyie ninye, pee meitoki amanya toki atua ninye, aa tung'ani aashu eng'ues, naa keaku olmuaate ntarasi.
“Ore pee indip aisuma ena buku, teeniki ninye isoito ninang'aki empolos olkeju le Frati,
nijo, ‘Nji eikoni Babilon aaimisie, pee meigil ae kata adumunye, tenkaraki ina torroni nayau nanu shumata ninye.’ ”
Ene ebaiki irorei le Yeremia.
